attachments.origin_landmark: long head: supraglenoid tubercle (via intra-articular tendon through the glenohumeral joint); short head: coracoid process (with coracobrachialis)
attachments.insertion_landmark: radial tuberosity (+ bicipital aponeurosis blending into antebrachial fascia)

via_points.active_over_joint_range: all glenohumeral positions -- long head tendon is constrained within the groove by the transverse humeral ligament

functional_compartments.name: Long head

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: mid-belly single endplate band, typical of parallel-fibered muscle

functional_compartments.function_note: Crosses both glenohumeral and elbow joints; contributes to shoulder stability/flexion in addition to elbow flexion/supination.
functional_compartments.source: Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity musculoskeletal model; Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)

functional_compartments.name: Short head
functional_compartments.function_note: Crosses only the elbow (and slightly the shoulder via coracoid); more purely an elbow flexor/supinator than the long head.
functional_compartments.source: Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity musculoskeletal model; Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity musculoskeletal model
